summary:
Iter 75 — Frontend-only verification of the FULL icon-system migration + toast wiring across web (React) and mobile (Expo web preview). Both surfaces render without runtime errors on every spot-checked route, and the mobile Boat-Pro review-submit toasts (warning + success) are correctly wired.

WEB spot-check (7 unauth routes + 6 authed routes as jenn@sailmorenow.com admin): / (Landing), /directory, /clubs, /events, /feed, /community-hub, /pricing, /dashboard, /crew-bank, /messages, /profile, /my-events, /reviews — ALL render with 0 pageerrors and 0 'element type is invalid / undefined component' console errors. Icon counts (svg) are healthy on every route (Landing 44, Directory 25, Clubs 17, Events 103, Feed 28, Hub 9, Pricing 19, Dashboard 11, Crew-Bank 13, Messages 8, Profile 11, My-Events 14, Reviews 11). Landing role selector: all 4 pins render icons via <Icon> wrapper (sailor=users, boat_owner=sailboat, boat_pro=handshake, partner=burgee). /clubs shows the burgee flag as the avatar-fallback on each org card as required. /events shows the List/Map view-toggle icons + all 5 category chips (All/Racing/Cruising-Social/Education/Volunteering/Other) + event rows. Reviews page renders 'Rate first. See second.' with awaiting counterparty card. Header renders theme toggle, notifications bell, admin badge and avatar with all icons intact.

MOBILE spot-check (11 routes) as jenn: /, /clubs, /directory, /events, /hub, /crew-bank, /messages, /profile, /notifications, /pricing, /new-post — ALL render, 0 pageerrors on every route. Icons render inline via @expo/vector-icons font glyphs. Verified with a DOM audit that NO icon container is oversized (footprint=size is honored — 0 oversize containers ≥44px around a <24px glyph across all screens). /clubs (mobile) shows the burgee flag icon on each of the 4 org avatar fallbacks. /directory (Boat Pros tab) shows the 'Clubs & Orgs' header shortcut with the burgee flag icon at top-right. Bottom tab bar (Hub, Events, Boat Pros, Messages, Profile) renders correctly.

MOBILE toast — Boat-Pro review submit (Directory > North Sound Rigging Co.): (a) tapping submit-review-btn with no star rating shows [data-testid="toast-warning"] with text 'Pick a rating' + the warning <Icon>; (b) selecting 4 stars, filling the review-comment-input with 'TEST review from testing agent', tapping submit-review-btn shows [data-testid="toast-success"] with text 'Review posted — thanks for sharing!' + the success <Icon>, and the pro's rating updated live from 3.7 (3 reviews) → 3.8 (4 reviews) with Jenn McDonald's 4-star review appearing in the list. Both toast flows work exactly as spec'd.

Previous mobile toasts (RSVP, new-post, profile save, DM error) were verified in iter74 and remain intact. Reactions error toast on failure was NOT re-exercised in this run because success is silent by design and forcing an API failure requires a non-premium user without password (would need to mint a session for a non-premium seeded user); code path is trusted based on iter73/74 static review.

ui_bugs.issue: Web dev server has a permanent 'Failed to compile' overlay in the preview: '[eslint] Failed to load config "react-app" to extend from. Referenced from: /app/frontend/.eslintrc.json'. Root cause: /app/frontend/.eslintrc.json line 2 extends 'react-app' but eslint-config-react-app is NOT in /app/frontend/package.json (only @eslint/js, eslint, eslint-plugin-{import,jsx-a11y,react,react-hooks} are). Package is missing from node_modules (confirmed). Impact: the CRA red-overlay covers the app on every route until dismissed (hard-reload keeps the overlay), and any subsequent source edits will NOT hot-reload (webpack keeps serving the last-good bundle). Production `yarn build` will also fail with this same error. The runtime bundle currently served is the last successful compile so pages LOOK fine once the overlay is removed, but the guard is non-functional.

react_native_issues.issue: Still emits 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' on web preview from ToastContext.tsx useNativeDriver:true. Benign but noisy. Reference: /app/mobile/src/context/ToastContext.tsx:47,57
RN-Web deprecation warning still present. Move pointerEvents='box-none' into style.pointerEvents in ToastContext.tsx:83.

action_items: HIGH: Fix /app/frontend/.eslintrc.json ESLint config. Either (a) install `eslint-config-react-app` (yarn add -D eslint-config-react-app@^7) so the current `extends: ['react-app']` resolves, OR (b) switch the extends to use the plugins actually installed (e.g. `plugin:react/recommended` + `plugin:react-hooks/recommended` + `plugin:jsx-a11y/recommended`) and remove the react-app reference. Without this, dev-server hot reload is broken and `yarn build` will fail — the icon-import guard is effectively bypassed at runtime because webpack refuses to emit a fresh bundle.
MINOR (carried over from iter74): Gate Animated useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' and move pointerEvents to style in /app/mobile/src/context/ToastContext.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Icon migration is clean end-to-end at the DOM level: 0 pageerrors and 0 'element type is invalid' console errors across 13 web routes and 11 mobile routes. All previously-listed 'reference sites' (ThemeToggle, ShareButton, LiveNowWidget, CommunityHub, Events category chips, MyEvents/AdminAnalytics stat cards, EventRow/EventDetailModal category badges, Header invite button, org burgee avatars, mobile role selector on Landing) render correctly.

Mobile footprint={size} is honored — DOM audit found ZERO icon containers >=44px width wrapping a <24px glyph across every mobile screen tested, confirming icons stay inline and are not blown up to a 48pt touch target.

Boat-Pro review submit toasts are wired correctly: warning ('Pick a rating') on empty rating and success ('Review posted — thanks for sharing!') on success both use the ToastContext <Icon> NAME map. The success mutation also updates the aggregate rating and review count on-screen (3.7/3 → 3.8/4).

The web .eslintrc.json guard is a good idea but is currently a self-inflicted foot-gun — the missing `eslint-config-react-app` peer means dev server never compiles fresh source. Please install it (or restructure the extends) before shipping. Until this is fixed, the ESLint guard on lucide-react imports is effectively not being applied to source changes.

success_rate.frontend: web 13/13 routes render clean (7 unauth + 6 authed) ; mobile 11/11 routes render clean + 2/2 review-toast flows pass (warning + success) — 26/26 assertions. One HIGH-priority build issue (ESLint config extends a missing package) surfaces as a CRA overlay in the preview but does not break the served runtime.

test_credentials: Web + mobile: jenn@sailmorenow.com / [REDACTED] (admin). Mobile session seeded via POST /api/auth/login then localStorage['session_token']=JSON.stringify(token) init script per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST review posted by Jenn on pro seed_rigging (North Sound Rigging Co.) — 4★ / 'TEST review from testing agent'. Consider cleanup if a fresh baseline is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: (a) The web /app/frontend/.eslintrc.json extends 'react-app' but eslint-config-react-app is NOT in the frontend package.json — this makes CRA show a persistent 'Failed to compile' overlay in the preview and would break `yarn build`. The runtime is unaffected only because webpack is serving the last-good bundle from before .eslintrc.json was added. If you edit any frontend src file, changes will NOT hot-reload until this is fixed. (b) Mobile Boat-Pro review testIDs: star-1..star-5, review-comment-input, submit-review-btn. Warning/success toasts have testids toast-warning / toast-success. (c) /api/boat-pros returns a list of pros with user_id — use e.g. seed_rigging for review flows. (d) There is no /api/pros or /api/directory endpoint; use /api/boat-pros. (e) Mobile authed screens (jenn admin) may show the Hub tab as default landing on '/'. (f) Reactions error-toast path (mobile Reactions.tsx) was NOT re-exercised in this iter — needs a non-premium seed user without password to force a 402; consider adding a scriptable stub or minting a free-tier user without $6.99 tier for this. (g) Icon migration is clean — 0 undefined-component runtime errors across all tested surfaces.
rca of the issue: ESLint config regression: iter74's `.eslintrc.json` uses `extends: ['react-app']` (the CRA-recommended shorthand which requires `eslint-config-react-app` as a runtime peer), but the frontend's package.json only ships modern flat-config peers (@eslint/js, eslint-plugin-{react,react-hooks,jsx-a11y,import}). Node resolution therefore fails to find `eslint-config-react-app`, CRA emits a compile error, and the CRA dev overlay renders on every page. Fix: `yarn add -D eslint-config-react-app@^7` OR rewrite `extends` to explicitly reference the installed plugin recommended configs. The guard on `no-restricted-imports` for lucide-react is orthogonal and remains fine once the extends is repaired.
